title: Evidence Briefing Board — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Build the alternatives
scenes.purpose: Show three options for connecting an idea to its system on one board, at one drawing scale and under one common spec.
visuals: Fixed frontal engineering board with grid
Three equal option panels: A isolated, B chain, C hub + ring

beats.development: Idea nodes and nodes pop in per option; B chain and C spokes/ring draw on; the clearance guide fades in over Option A.
captions: AN IDEA BECOMES A CONNECTED SYSTEM
COMMON SPEC · 5 NODES · ALL LINKED · WITHIN 2 HOPS OF THE IDEA

scenes.title: One guide crosses every option
scenes.purpose: Apply the same moving r = 2 hops clearance guide to each option at one constant speed and stamp a verdict where it is centred.
visuals: Moving dashed clearance ring with vertical scan line and GUIDE r = 2 tag

beats.development: Guide centred on A: ring stamped, chip '✕ 0 LINKS' revealed after its box completes.
Guide centred on B: ring stamped, chain extends beyond it, chip '✕ 4 HOPS · EXCEEDS GUIDE'.
Guide centred on C: ring stamped, chip '✓ FEASIBLE · MAX 1 HOP'.

scenes.title: Hold the feasible arrangement
scenes.purpose: Mark Option C as the feasible system and hold the full board for comparison.
visuals: Option C frame turns active blue 4 px
Brief 5% emphasis pulse on C diagram, guide fades out

beats.development: C frame takes the active stroke, diagram pulses once and settles by 2.4 s; whole board held still and readable.
captions: UNITS: HOPS FROM IDEA NODE · SAME CLEARANCE GUIDE APPLIED TO EACH OPTION · SHEET 01/01

findings: Guide travels 792 px in 1.2 s at linear 660 px/s, equal for all options.
All motion settles by 2.4 s, before the 2.7 s requirement.
justifiedHolds: 2.4–3.0 s hold on the feasible arrangement, as the style requires.

notes: No reviewed preview_recipes in STYLE.json (none supplied); preview demonstrates the characteristic action: same moving clearance guide across each option, hold on feasible.
Diagram is an illustrative schematic, not measured data.
